messages:
sre-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: KV prefetch queue growth detected on shard set g-12. Paging rate increased x6 in the last 3m, continuous-batch size has spiked +4x. Streaming token cadence showing gaps -> partial flush events observed. Auto-escalation to on-call. Thread created 2234567890
jamie_oncall: I'm on it. grabbing current dashboards now. who's on runtime? @olivia_runtime ?
olivia_runtime: looking. seeing large prefix cache insert churn on node g-12-4. KV bloom false-positive rate jumped, causing many evictions and re-population. tail latency rising.
ethan_ml: this smells like prefetch policy runaway + continuous-batching combining hot prefixes into huge batches. any recent rollouts to prefetch config?
lina_support: reported by a customer (acct: zephyr-labs) that they started seeing stalled streaming responses ~ 2:02pm UTC. They have partial tokens and then long silence.
jamie_oncall: timeline: alert at 14:05 UTC, customer complaint at 14:06. Current impact: ~0.8% of streaming sessions experiencing >5s token gap; some timeouts at 15s. Non-streaming generation unaffected mostly.
olivia_runtime: pulling hotstack logs. snippet:

```
[14:04:55] kv_cache.cpp:insert prefix_len=256 key=0x7f9a... evict_count=128 bloom_fp=0.18
[14:04:55] continuous_batcher.cpp:enqueue batch_size=6144 tokens queued=1.2M
[14:04:58] streaming_outbound.cpp:partial_flush id=abc123 reason=kv_page_wait
```

olivia_runtime: batch_size 6144 is insane for our default policy. that explains cadence stalls — streaming tokens get held until batch fill or page fetch completes.
ethan_ml: can we temporarily cap continuous batch max_tokens to something sane (e.g., 512) via runtime config? Patch should be safe to toggle.
jamie_oncall: agree. let's do a config hotfix and scale down prefetch aggressiveness. Who can push the runtime config? @olivia_runtime or @jamie_oncall?
olivia_runtime: I can push a config via the ops endpoint. Preparing patch: set continuous_batch.max_tokens=512, prefetch.window_multiplier=0.5, kv.bloom.fp_target=0.01. will apply to shard group g-12 first as canary.
jamie_oncall: deploy-bot, schedule canary rollout to g-12 (1 node) now.
deploy-bot: Starting canary rollout: targets=[g-12-4], config_patch_id=cfg-2026-03-15-01. Expected window 45s. Will post back on completion.
olivia_runtime: applying patch...
[progress logs]
deploy-bot: Canary complete on g-12-4. No crashes. Monitoring metrics for 2m.
ethan_ml: while canary runs, can we throttle prefetch from cloudside for zephyr-labs to reduce customer impact? Lina, can you create a temporary customer-level override?
lina_support: creating rate-limit override now (scoped to prefetch=off for zephyr-labs). Patch ID cus-9876. will apply in 30s. notifying customer: "We are applying a mitigation to reduce prefetch to your traffic — you may see marginally higher token compute but it should restore streaming cadence."
jamie_oncall: good. metrics update?
olivia_runtime: after canary: paging rate on g-12-4 dropped ~75%, continuous_batch.avg_size down from 4k->420, partial_flush events dropped to near zero. token cadence gap 95th percentile improved from 6.8s -> 0.6s on canary node.
jamie_oncall: roll to remaining g-12 nodes but be conservative: serial rollout with 60s observation windows. start now.
deploy-bot: Starting serial rollout to [g-12-1, g-12-2, g-12-3] with pause=60s between nodes.
[rollout logs]
olivia_runtime: roll completed. cluster-wide paging rate back to baseline. streaming token stalls resolved in most zones.
ethan_ml: need postmortem actions: 1) add a safety hard cap on continuous_batch.max_tokens to prevent runaway, 2) add early-detection alert for continuous_batch.avg_size > 2k, 3) tweak prefetch policy to be more conservative for cold keys.
jamie_oncall: agreed. immediate follow-ups: - Escalate to eng-runtime for root cause analysis (olivia+ethan). - Create customer comms draft (lina). - Schedule config change to make the hotfix permanent if RCA recommends.
lina_support: filed customer incident note and emailed zephyr-labs primary. they acknowledged and say restored but want RCA.
olivia_runtime: quick notes: cause = prefetch window multiplier + bloom FP increase => aggressive re-population -> batch amplification -> streaming stalls due to KV page wait. Root fix likely combination of bloom tuning and prefetch heuristics + fail-safe cap on batch size.
jamie_oncall: handoff summary for next shift (timestamp 2234568480): incident declared 14:05 UTC, mitigation applied 14:10-14:16 (canary then rollout), customer impact limited to ~0.8% of streams with transient token gaps, mitigation successful. Action items created: IR-2026-031 (RCA), CFG-2026-014 (permanent config), ALERT-2026-078 (new metric alert). Assigning owners: olivia_runtime (RCA), ethan_ml (prefetch heuristics), lina_support (customer comms).
deploy-bot: Incident status: resolved - monitoring.
jamie_oncall: thanks team. if anything regresses ping this thread. handing off to night oncall. :white_check_mark:
